1.title: Continuous Optimization, Blending, Piecewise LP, QP & Duality
1.description: Turn business rules into linear programs, handle ratios and minimax balance cleanly, exploit objective direction, build convex QP portfolios, and interpret dual shadow prices.

2.title: Mixed-Integer Programming (MIP) Formulation Idioms
2.description: Fixed-charge lot sizing, indicator directions, chained logic, SOS2 piecewise approximation, McCormick envelopes, and pattern enumeration.

3.title: Propositional Logic & SMT Modeling
3.description: Uniqueness proofs via no-good cuts, Minesweeper refutation, policy verification, minimal Unsat Core extraction, MaxSAT repair, and SMT-LIRA.

4.title: Constraint Programming (CP / LCG) & Global Constraints
4.description: AllDifferent (distinct), Element (at), Table (allowed), NoOverlap (disjoint), Cumulative scheduling, 2D packing, symmetry breaking, and MIP vs CP vs SMT paradigm comparison.

5.title: Networks, Total Unimodularity, Connectivity & Vehicle Routing
5.description: Exploit total unimodularity, max-flow min-cut, flow-based connectivity without subtours, CVRP, VRPTW, and connected territory design.

6.title: Production, Inventory, Supply Chain & Energy Systems
6.description: Strong lot-sizing reformulations, multi-level BOM/MRP, backorders vs lost sales, facility location (CFLP), Unit Commitment, and battery arbitrage.

7.title: Scheduling, Staff Rostering, Timetabling & Revenue Management
7.description: Job-shop comparison (MIP vs CP), RCPSP, rolling night-rest rosters, university timetabling, OR scheduling, and seat allocation.

8.title: Requirements Auditing, Model Debugging & Acceleration
8.description: Expose fake hard constraints with historical data, diagnose Infeasible/Unbounded/Unrealistic models, loophole testing, Unsat Core vs elastic slacks, and warm starts.

9.title: Multi-Objective Tradeoffs, Fairness, Rescheduling & Uncertainty
9.description: Goal programming, lexicographic optimization, Pareto frontiers, fairness metrics, Hamming-distance rescheduling, 2-stage stochastic LP, CVaR, and robust optimization.

10.title: Large-Scale Decomposition & Hybrid Solvers
10.description: Lazy cuts, cutting-stock/VRP column generation, Dantzig-Wolfe, classical & logic-based Benders decomposition, Lagrangian relaxation, LNS, and integrated S&OP Capstone.
